title: missing required field
notes: Names the missing field. 'field' is schema vocabulary for what the user experiences as a function definition. Location 1 -> 2 (phase-3 item 7): `  in defs.f` names the block that lacks `return:`. A *missing* field has no mark of its own, so the enclosing block is the correct target rather than an approximation to one -- and `defs.f` is a real path that exists in the source, which is what separates this from E-TYPE-003.
